item.description: I am a a Ph.D. Candidate at Structural Monitoring, Diagnostics and Prognostics Lab (SMDP) at the University of Vermont (UVM), co-supervised by Dr. Eric. M. Hernandez and Dr. David V. Rosowsky. My research interests lie at the intersection of disaster resilience, structural engineering, control systems engineering and computer science.
